entries.name: get-json
entries.description: Requests JSON over HTTP, raises on an error status, and decodes the response body.
entries.definition: Requests JSON over HTTP, raises on an error status, and decodes the response body.
entries.template:
import requests

response = requests.get({url}, timeout={timeout})
response.raise_for_status()
data = response.json()

entries.name: post-json
entries.description: Serializes a Python value as JSON and validates the response status.
entries.definition: Serializes a Python value as JSON and validates the response status.
entries.template:
import requests

payload = {payload}
response = requests.post({url}, json=payload, timeout={timeout})
response.raise_for_status()

entries.name: session-headers
entries.description: Creates a Requests session with shared headers and uses it for a request.
entries.definition: Creates a Requests session with shared headers and uses it for a request.
entries.template:
import requests

with requests.Session() as session:
    session.headers.update({headers})
    response = session.get({url}, timeout={timeout})
    response.raise_for_status()
